findings.reason: Renders 84 cells for a 1-digit count (en 71) against the 74-cell detail width at 80x24; the 'elif clause' ladder (settings_view.py L5268-5275) then sheds every clause rung, so at the default terminal size the ru page never shows how many sessions cleanup will delete; the proposal measures 74 at a 3-digit count and reuses the shipped 'с перезапуска' (tui.settings_view.scope.new_launch). Derived from code and cell_len, not from a rendered frame.
'this' is load-bearing: only this running session keeps its stricter gate, and bare 'сессия' reads as sessions in general.
